in_sanskrit.name: Choto
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little, Young One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Choto एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chaturthi', which translates to 'fourth'. In Hindu mythology, Choto is a term used to refer to the younger sister or the younger one in general.
